name: room_seedream-5-lite
prompt: An empty university seminar room at night, seen from the back corner: a long dark wooden table with five empty chairs in a row behind it facing a single empty chair alone in the middle of the bare floor. A projector on the table throws a hard white beam through the dark air onto a blank pale screen. A large blank clean black chalkboard on the wall, completely empty. A single cold fluorescent ceiling panel lights the table from above, the rest of the room falls into darkness. Tall black windows. Cinematic night photograph, 16:9 wide frame, high contrast, deep black shadows, hard directional light, clean readable geometry, strong silhouettes, minimal clutter, sharp focus, anamorphic film still. No text, no signs, no lettering, no logos, no people.
